<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Licenciement" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Licenciement" name="Licenciement"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Licenciement">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPON" name="MPON" processRef="Process_MPON"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPOO" name="MPOO" processRef="Process_MPOO"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Licenciement" name="Licenciement" sourceRef="SendTask_Envoyer_Licenciement" targetRef="MessageStartEvent_Licenciement_Recu"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPON" name="Processus MPON" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MPON" name="Début">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPON_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Envoyer_Licenciement" name="Envoyer le licenciement au MPOO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPON_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MPON" name="Licenciement envoyé">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_MPON" targetRef="SendTask_Envoyer_Licenciement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_2" sourceRef="SendTask_Envoyer_Licenciement" targetRef="EndEvent_MPON"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPOO" name="Processus MPOO" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="MessageStartEvent_Licenciement_Recu" name="Licenciement reçu">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Licenciement" messageRef="Message_Licenciement"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Examiner_Licenciement" name="Examiner le licenciement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision_MPOO" name="Décision du MPOO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Licenciement_Conteste" name="Licenciement contesté par le MPOO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Licenciement_Confirme" name="Licenciement confirmé par le MPOO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_1" sourceRef="MessageStartEvent_Licenciement_Recu" targetRef="Task_Examiner_Licenciement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_2" sourceRef="Task_Examiner_Licenciement" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_MPOO"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_3" name="Opposition" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_MPOO" targetRef="EndEvent_Licenciement_Conteste"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_4" name="Confirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_MPOO" targetRef="EndEvent_Licenciement_Confirme"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
